transcript: Turning out to be a good Monday for Indian equity markets. Although there's still a lot of uncertainty on the geopolitical front with Brent sustaining above that $105 per barrel. Indian equity markets are clearly in good shape this afternoon. We have Nifty which has jumped up nearly 1% in today's trading session to trade above that 24,200 mark and banking and financial services stocks are also doing for them well for themselves in trade today. In terms of other sectoral movers, let's talk about the Nifty real estate because that sector is doing very well. It is the biggest sectoral gainer. We have Godrej Properties, DLF, all of them surging in trade. Godrej Properties, remember, will be reporting its numbers for the fourth quarter. In terms of other movers, we have a couple of earnings reactions. Kotak Mahindra Bank, despite reporting strong set of numbers, the stock is down 2 and 1/2%. So is the case with Avenue Supermart. Strong set of numbers, but the stock is reacting negatively. In terms of other reactions, we have something like Netweb, which is reacting negatively to the numbers that it reported. So yes, all in all, several individual stocks that are in focus, but on the index level turning out to be a good day. Nifty above that 24,200 mark.
